_comment: Maps school-name variants (as printed in the record books) to a single canonical name so the same school joins across tables. Keys are matched case-insensitively against the raw name AFTER whitespace cleanup; values are the canonical display name. This map is intentionally conservative and hand-curated — accuracy over coverage. verify_record_book.py lists champion schools that still don't match a school-records name; review those against the PDF and add entries here deliberately. Do not add a mapping unless you are certain the two names are the same school.
